parameters.query:
WITH prev AS (
  SELECT count(*)::int AS c FROM workflow_errors
  WHERE workflow_name = $1 AND node_name = $2 AND left(error_message, 300) = $3
    AND created_at > now() - interval '30 minutes'
), ins AS (
  INSERT INTO workflow_errors (workflow_name, node_name, execution_id, execution_url, error_message)
  VALUES ($1, $2, $4, $5, $3)
  RETURNING error_id
)
SELECT ins.error_id, prev.c AS recent_similar_count, (prev.c > 0) AS is_duplicate FROM ins, prev

parameters.content: WF07 - Error monitoring. Set this as the Error Workflow (workflow settings) on each of WF01-WF06 AFTER publishing it. Logs every error to workflow_errors with secrets redacted. Identical errors (same workflow + node + message) within 30 minutes are logged but alert only once. Only the Telegram alert is retried (3 tries, 3s apart); n8n cannot limit node retries to specific status codes. It does NOT re-run failed workflows. Needs: Postgres + Telegram credentials, variable ADMIN_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.
